div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
多机位时间轴窗口 t 输入
(多轨音轨 + 各机位人脸视频流)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
计算每位嘉宾的音视联合激活得分
TalkNet Lip-VAD Score S_ASD(k, t)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
当前时间窗有几位嘉宾
S_ASD >= 0.75 (正在张嘴说话)?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 保持当前机位不变 (Hold Current Camera)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
✅ 切换至全景机位 (Wide Shot)
或双人并排分屏 (2-Up Split Screen)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
前向预读该次发言总时长
Duration(k) >= 1.2s?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
距离上一次切镜是否已满
最小保持门限 τ_min >= 1.8s?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
✅ 在第一个音节前 400ms 预切至 Cam_k
(若连续独白 >24s 则自动穿插 2.5s 倾听点头镜头)
